_doc: Prompts an AI assistant is graded on, against the demo library in the perf-eval profile (npm run eval:setup). Each case: prompt (+ followUps, sent as later turns of the same session), scopes (AI control switches on for this case; all others off), paused, files (written into the music copy before launch, relative to its root), setup (control API requests after launch), expect: calls (in order, each a tool name or {tool, args} subset — $absent/$present/$match), forbidden, maxCalls, answer {includes, excludes, matches}, state ({get: path} or {sql}, read with `at`, checked by equals/matches/gte/lte/includes/some). Graded by scripts/lib/assistantEval.mjs; see .claude/rules/testing.md → 'Assistant eval'.

cases.prompt: What song is loaded in the player right now, and is it playing?
Play the album OK Computer by Radiohead from the first track.
After the current song, play Teardrop by Massive Attack. Don't change anything else in the queue.
Start a radio station based on Go Your Own Way by Fleetwood Mac.
How many tracks by Miles Davis are in my library?
There's a song in my library with the line "ten thousand tiny suns". Which song is it?
I love Dreams by Fleetwood Mac. Like it for me.

state.sql: SELECT liked FROM entity_likes WHERE kind = 'track' AND entity_key = 'track:fleetwood mac:dreams'

cases.prompt: I'm sick of Levitating by Dua Lipa. Mark it as disliked.

state.sql: SELECT liked FROM entity_likes WHERE kind = 'track' AND entity_key = 'track:dua lipa:levitating'

cases.prompt: Make a playlist called "Rainy Sunday" with the first three tracks of Kind of Blue, in album order.

state.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist_tracks pt JOIN playlists p ON p.id = pt.playlist_id WHERE p.name = 'Rainy Sunday'
SELECT pt.title FROM playlist_tracks pt JOIN playlists p ON p.id = pt.playlist_id WHERE p.name = 'Rainy Sunday' ORDER BY pt.position LIMIT 1

cases.prompt: Tag every track on the album Tidewater Hymns with "ambient". Only in the library, don't touch the files.

state.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM track_tags tt JOIN tags g ON g.id = tt.tag_id JOIN tracks t ON t.id = tt.track_id JOIN albums a ON a.id = t.album_id WHERE lower(g.name) = 'ambient' AND a.title = 'Tidewater Hymns'

cases.prompt: Write the year 1997 into the file tags of every track on OK Computer.
My compilation Late Night Drive shows up as a dozen separate albums. Fix it so it's one album by Various Artists, and write the fix into the files.

state.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.album_id) FROM tracks t JOIN albums a ON a.id = t.album_id WHERE a.title = 'Late Night Drive'

cases.prompt: The band Glass Harbour should be spelled Glass Harbor (American spelling) everywhere: the file tags, the library and my listening history.

state.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks t JOIN artists ar ON ar.id = t.artist_id WHERE ar.name = 'Glass Harbor'

cases.prompt: Delete the track Foghorn Lullaby from my library.

state.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks WHERE title = 'Foghorn Lullaby'
